title: Another one…
content: I had a dream I was shopping in a mall that had a second floor with stores (almost mall within a mall) that I never accessed. I finally went to the level then I wanted to purchase an item but there was no changing rooms so I went to the bathroom. This lady said it was $2 to use but I refused to pay, some people were just hanging out in the bathroom. I tried the item on but didn’t purchase it. Went back and walked around, again not on the second raised shops but at the ones on ground level. Why do we dream this, it was nearly lucid, very vivid.
